easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate Masked Meower by discarding a card and sacrificing it.
When Masked Meower dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Masked Meower from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Masked Meower ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
